await page.evaluate('async () => {\n  const res = await fetch(\'/src/data/documents.ts\');\n  const text = await res.text();\n  // find document blocks: look for pattern id: \'xxx\', ... title: ... relatedDocuments: [...]\n  const docRegex = /id:\\s*[\'"]([a-z0-9-]+)[\'"],\\s*title:\\s*[\'"]([^\'"]+)[\'"][\\s\\S]*?relatedDocuments:\\s*\\[([^\\]]*)\\]/g;\n  let m; const results = [];\n  while ((m = docRegex.exec(text)) !== null) {\n    results.push({ id: m[1], title: m[2], related: m[3].replace(/\\s+/g,\' \').trim() });\n  }\n  return results;\n}');
